mapper.select: SELECT refund_order_id,refunded_amount,order_stage,payment_status, verification_status,cancel_reason FROM pet_order WHERE id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT refund_order_id,payment_id,refund_type,refund_source,refund_amount, refund_status,created_event_id,success_event_id,succeeded_at FROM order_late_refund_result WHERE order_id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_order SET refund_order_id=#{refundOrderId},version=version+1, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND refund_order_id IS NULL AND refunded_amount=0 AND order_stage='CANCELED' AND cancel_reason='PAYMENT_TIMEOUT' AND payment_status='PAID' AND verification_status='UNVERIFIED'

UPDATE pet_order SET refund_order_id=#{refundOrderId},refunded_amount=#{refundedAmount},version=version+1, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND (refund_order_id IS NULL OR refund_order_id=#{refundOrderId}) AND refunded_amount=0 AND order_stage='CANCELED' AND cancel_reason='PAYMENT_TIMEOUT' AND payment_status='PAID' AND verification_status='UNVERIFIED'
UPDATE order_late_refund_result SET created_event_id=#{eventId},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND refund_status='SUCCESS' AND created_event_id IS NULL

UPDATE order_late_refund_result SET refund_status='SUCCESS',success_event_id=#{eventId},succeeded_at=#{succeededAt}, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND refund_status='CREATED' AND success_event_id IS NULL
